gen-gf-paprika-gf-winky-rough: Scattered and loud: Paprika spaces its letters out with open counters and plenty of command. Winky Rough, a sans with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, can sit a size or two below the heading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-winky-sans: Paprika scatters its letters at a distance, its counters breathing like a hollow reed cut open, which gives headings a commanding presence. Winky Sans keeps text gliding, its capitals barely above lowercase.
gen-gf-paprika-plus-jakarta-sans: Expressive from the first letter, Paprika scatters its forms at a distance while its lowercase stands high. Plus Jakarta Sans settles lower, its monoline strokes giving the loud heading room.
gen-gf-phudu-clash-grotesk: Phudu draws every curve with generous terminal openings and a ballpoint's pressure-free line, giving the heading a bold, distinctive look. Clash Grotesk, a sans-serif with no stroke modulation, shares that pressure-free line.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-almarai: Distinctive from the first glance, Phudu opens its curves wide and draws with a ballpoint's pressure-free line. Almarai never pinches a letter shut, and its uniform line echoes the heading's openness.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-amarna: Bold in every curve, Phudu leaves generous terminal openings and keeps a ballpoint's pressure-free line weight. Amarna, a sans-serif with contrast-free strokes, carries that openness right down to its smallest counters.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-antic: Phudu draws its curves with generous terminal openings, a ballpoint's pressure-free line giving it a bold, distinctive voice. Antic, a sans-serif drawn as if with one nib, keeps open mouths, so both fonts feel unclenched.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ar-one-sans: Open-ended and pen-plain: Phudu leaves generous terminal openings on every curve with a steady, unvarying line. And if the heading shrinks small, Phudu's steady line loses force beside AR One Sans, whose brush ends lift away.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters connected to the outside and adds a restrained swell to curved strokes. Phudu's steady, marker-like heading line makes that gentle modulation stand out.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-chakra-petch: Chakra Petch reads professional and contemporary, its round letters looking cupped rather than clenched. And because its stroke keeps a single width, text beneath Phudu's bold heading moves along smoothly.
